remarks: Welcome to this exceptional home set on a quiet cul-de-sac in one of Wilton's most sought-after neighborhoods. Offering 5 spacious bedrooms, 5 full baths &1 half bath, this home seamlessly blends timeless elegance with modern comfort. The sun-drenched interiors highlighted by gorgeous windows fill the space with natural light including new windows in the semi circle area. Extensive high-gloss millwork & striking coffered ceilings showcase the home's craftsmanship and refined architectural detail throughout. The thoughtfully designed floor plan is ideal for both everyday living & entertaining, featuring a gourmet kitchen w/high-end appliances, custom cabinetry, & center island. A stylish butler's pantry add both function & sophistication, making hosting effortless. The kitchen flows seamlessly into gracious living and dining spaces designed for gathering.Upstairs, the luxurious primary suite serves as a private retreat, complete w/a spa-like bathroom & generous walk-in closets. Each additional bedroom is well-proportioned w/access to beautifully appointed full baths, offering comfort & privacy for family & guests alike.The LL offers flexible living spaces perfect for a home office, gym, or media room w/a stone fireplace & full bath. Outside, a beautiful approach highlights the professionally landscaped grounds designed by Glen Gate, creating a picturesque setting. The level, walk-out expansive patio provides an ideal backyard backdrop for outdoor entertaining or relaxation!
